note: People born in Puerto Rico are United States citizens and hold its passport, at its fees.

sources.title: United States Code, 2023 edition (govinfo.gov), 8 U.S.C. § 1402, Persons born in Puerto Rico on or after April 11, 1899
sources.said: All persons born in Puerto Rico on or after January 13, 1941, and subject to the jurisdiction of the United States, are citizens of the United States at birth.

sources.title: United States Code, 2023 edition (govinfo.gov), 22 U.S.C. § 212, Persons entitled to passport
sources.said: No passport shall be granted or issued to or verified for any other persons than those owing allegiance, whether citizens or not, to the United States.
